candidate: H58 layer/token-conditioned shared residual rank-one atlas

parent_evidence.causal_transition: H57's shared carrier raises heldout covariance from 57.65% to 65.70% but worsens JVP RMSE from 0.712 to 0.780. Token-conditioned hidden-group routing adds only 0.11 covariance points over static gates. Move conditioning from coarse pre-GELU groups to the residual carrier coordinates themselves.

scientific_question: Can layer/token-conditioned coefficients over a charged global rank-one residual atlas preserve teacher outputs and exact input JVPs under one percent latent coordinates?

frozen_teacher.procedural_parent_policy: Use exact step-zero MLP tensors in the audit; exclude them from the compact artifact and require independent config-seed regeneration identity before any later model training.

frozen_representation.formula: y0_l=B0_l GELU(A0_l x); c_l=s_l+a_l*tanh(Tx+b_l); y_l=y0_l+((y0_l V)*c_l)U^T

initialization.carrier_v: first 192 columns of deterministic float64 QR with positive diagonal convention, cast to float32
initialization.initial_function: exact step-zero procedural MLP because carrier U is zero

fit.objective: mean relative output MSE plus 0.25 times relative exact input-JVP MSE
fit.layer_schedule: deterministic round-robin over all twelve layers

controls.static_layer_coordinates: use c_l=s_l+a_l*tanh(b_l) with no token term or router derivative
controls.global_token_coordinates: replace every layer's fitted s/a/b by their across-layer means while retaining fitted T/U/V
controls.initial_random_router: replace fitted T by the exact deterministic initial T while retaining fitted private coordinates and carrier
controls.dense_teacher: exact terminal teacher output and input-JVP identity

runtime_gates.watchdog_policy: terminal/error callbacks plus one resettable 90-minute heartbeat for any run observed or projected above five minutes

promotion: Only an every-layer representation pass authorizes exact-config latency and MFU measurement. Only representation plus performance may authorize one 124M CE acquisition. A pass does not authorize scale-up or attention work.
failure: Close this exact layer/token-conditioned rank-192 residual atlas without rank, router, layer-coordinate, seed, optimizer, horizon, CE, attention, or scale sweeps.
forbidden: stored PCA or empirical trajectory basis
persistent FP16 or FP32 dense endpoint or carrier master
changing rank, conditioning location, initialization, optimizer, objective or gates after seeing results
CE, attention work or scale-up before representation and performance gates pass
